comment: Layouts and dockers makes a new docker, empty or forked, and deletes one. On a fresh profile the search for Fork brings the New docker row into view, and the row is typed Mine, given the start Empty and its Make pressed, all through layout_gesture. layout_rows then lists Mine's line with Elements and Delete, a shot of the page shows it, the docker stands open over the canvas and the Window menu lists it. A fork of the Toolbox called My Tools is made the same way, and the page stays where it was, so Mine's Delete is in reach. It asks, the answer is Delete, and layout_rows, the page and the Window menu no longer list Mine, while My Tools opens holding the fifteen tools. Preferences is closed by its own door, the step that opened it, because the docker Make opens takes the keyboard and an Escape goes to that docker.
